newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-HTV sees itself as bid target.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-HTV sees itself as bid target.

text.p: Welsh and west of England independent television franchise operator HTV Group conceded on Wednesday that it was a strategic target for other television companies but said it saw a strong independent future.

Chief executive Chris Rowlands told Reuters in an interview that he met with companies that have been tipped as potential bidders, such as Carlton Communications and United News & Media, two or three times a week to discuss "industry issues".
But he declined to comment on whether these talks have included a bid for the company.
"Within our industry we are in talks with everybody all the time," Rowlands said, adding, "Obviously we are a takeover target because we are successful and because we are very desirable."

He said the group, which earlier reported half year pretax profits at the top-end of expectations at 6.7 million stg, up 10 percent, now offered a key area in broadcasting terms and a successful business.
"Over the last four or five years everybody has either expected that we would go bust or be taken over," he said, but added that he could not run the business expecting a bid.
